summary: Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust filed a routine Form 8-K on September 18, 2026, furnishing under Items 7.01 and 8.01 the Q2-2026 consolidated financial statements of Penney Intermediate Holdings LLC for the three months ended August 1, 2026, along with Master Lease store performance disclosures and a related press release. The trust made these materials available on its investor website. The filing discloses no transaction, no special-situations event, and no board recommendation or advisor. This is an ordinary periodic disclosure; no deal terms or structural changes are stated.
